source.name: Bosch Brand Guide - Font and typography

ai_readable_summary.purpose: Organizes Bosch font and typography guidance into structured data for downstream AI, UX, design-system, and brand-compliance workflows.
ai_readable_summary.core_message: Bosch uses a proprietary font ecosystem designed to maintain brand consistency worldwide. Bosch Sans is the general-purpose corporate typeface, complemented by specialized families for serif typography, global scripts, script/accent use, iconography, office environments, technical marking, and pixel displays.
ai_readable_summary.ownership_and_scope: The Bosch font families are house fonts designed exclusively for Bosch and are the property of Robert Bosch GmbH. They are to be used worldwide under the Bosch brand to guarantee uniformity across applications.

primary_font_categories.name: Bosch Sans
primary_font_categories.role: Primary all-purpose corporate typeface for Western typesetting

additional_weights.usage_condition: May only be used for existing media and design concepts already approved by C/CGB-CD

primary_font_categories.name: Bosch Serif
primary_font_categories.role: Specialized serif font for representative long-form reading

primary_font_categories.name: Bosch Sans Global
primary_font_categories.role: Typeface for languages and scripts not fully covered by Latin-based Bosch Sans
implementation_notes: Not recommended as webfonts in full form
Localized subsets should be used when smaller file sizes are needed

primary_font_categories.name: Bosch Script
primary_font_categories.role: Expressive accent typeface based on Robert Bosch's handwriting
constraints: Should be used as an accentuation font only

primary_font_categories.name: Bosch Icons
primary_font_categories.role: Font containing Bosch icons, regularly updated
notes: Installed on Bosch computers by default
Icons can be inserted and colored in MS Office programs

further_fonts.name: Bosch Sans Office
further_fonts.role: Office application font based on Arial
further_fonts.usage: Embedded in MS Office templates and presentations and installed as a system font on all workstations.
constraints: Only to be used in Microsoft Office applications

further_fonts.name: Bosch Sans Condensed
further_fonts.usage: For special applications with limited space, such as catalogs, instructions, packaging, and tables.

further_fonts.name: Bosch Sans Mono SemiCondensed
further_fonts.usage: Replaces Bosch Mono Engraving and Bosch Sans Engraving. Used for product markings and nameplates in engraving, print, and preview contexts.

further_fonts.name: Bosch Sans Mono SemiCondensed Lined (Trumpf)
further_fonts.usage: Optimized for technical applications and OCR. Provided in .lfn format for laser machines such as Trumpf.

further_fonts.name: Bosch Sans Pixel
further_fonts.usage: For pixel displays, mainly in product user interfaces.

typesetting.case: Use mixed case for headings and body text whenever possible
typesetting.hierarchy_rule: Heading size should be at least 1.5 times the size of body text
typesetting.tracking_rule: Headings and body text above 28 pt are slightly undercut; the larger the headline, the more the tracking is undercut

color_usage.emphasis_recommendation: Use colored type selectively. Bosch Sans Bold is recommended for colored markups.

first_level.special_case_color: Accent colors may be used in special cases

second_level.usage: Used for both lists and enumerations

accessibility.principle: Font size and contrast must ensure readability for all users
accessibility.contrast_reference: AAA for continuous text as captured in the source summary
accessibility.text_on_images: Ensure text clearly stands out from the background

rules: Headlines are set in Bosch Sans Bold
Colored type is used only for orientation or intentional emphasis
Use headline, description, and buttons in a clear hierarchy

application_examples.context: Navigation in negative contrast or dark mode

font_formats.note: Not all font formats are intended for all usage. Usage should follow the provided format table in the source.

implementation_cautions: Do not use deprecated additional Bosch Sans weights for new media unless already approved
Avoid full Bosch Sans Global as a webfont due to large file size; prefer localized subsets
Use Bosch Script only as an accent, not as a replacement for Bosch Sans
Use Bosch Sans Office only inside Microsoft Office applications
